<DOCSTRING>
Summary: Validates and signs timestamps for a given value, ensuring the timestamp is within a valid range.

Description: Created to ensure timestamps are correctly validated and signed, preventing signature expiration and ensuring data integrity. Used by test fixtures to simulate signed timestamps in test scenarios.

Attributes:
    secret_key (str): The secret key used for signing and verifying timestamps. Set during initialization and used throughout the lifecycle of the signer.

Methods:
    test_max_age: Validates the signed timestamp against a maximum age, raising an error if the timestamp is expired.
    test_return_timestamp: Verifies the signed timestamp and returns the timestamp value alongside the decoded data.
    test_timestamp_missing: Ensures a BadTimeSignature is raised when the timestamp is missing.
    test_malformed_timestamp: Checks for a BadTimeSignature when the timestamp is malformed.
    test_malformed_future_timestamp: Validates that a future timestamp is rejected with a BadTimeSignature.
    test_future_age: Ensures a SignatureExpired error is raised for a future timestamp.
    test_sig_error_date_signed: Verifies that a BadTimeSignature is raised when the signature is malformed.
</DOCSTRING>
